title: Who Controls Congress? Stocks May Not Care | Dimensional
gist: Dimensional says history shows markets have rewarded investors regardless of which party controls Congress, so portfolios should not be changed around Capitol Hill majorities. The page is a short video teaser without the underlying data.

insights.claim: Dimensional Fund Advisors contends that equity markets have rewarded investors no matter which party controls Congress, so changing investments based on congressional control is unwarranted.
insights.speaker: Dimensional Fund Advisors
insights.so_what: Do not build a trade around midterm or congressional-majority outcomes; the firm's view is that party control is not a reliable return driver.
insights.quote: History shows that markets have rewarded investors, no matter who controls Congress.

insights.claim: The piece is filed under market volatility and investment principles, positioning the Congress question as a behavioural test of staying invested through election-driven uncertainty.
insights.speaker: Dimensional Fund Advisors
insights.so_what: Useful mainly as a reference point for the passive/strategic-allocation counter-argument to election-timing trades.
